scope: Residual pass, QS_FRM_ALI only. Where the local ALI of the coherent-scattering fixed point J = Phi(ETA + CHI_SCAT*J) has not converged after QS_ALI_MAX formal solutions (before: 'QS_FRM_ALI: scattering not converged', J left at the last iterate), the fixed point is solved by Newton's method: dPhi/dJ from one-sided differences (relative step 1e-6) of the same formal solution, ND+1 formal solutions per step, dense LU (DGESV), at most 10 steps, step halved (to 1e-3) to keep J > 0. Accepted only if every formal J is finite and >= 0 and the relative residual is below QS_ALI_TOL; otherwise TC and the ray store are recomputed from the last ALI iterate (the build-35 result, which is then reported unconverged as before). Opacities, emissivities, the negative-opacity option and the fixed point are unchanged; frequencies where the local ALI converges execute no new arithmetic. Cause: an inverted line under the SRCE_CHK/ESEC_CHK floor can leave CHI < CHI_SCAT (net absorption negative), CHI_SCAT*L* > 1, and the local ALI then has no contracting step (Report 24). Record: QSTARS_ALI_NEWTON (one line per fallback frequency and a summary at the last frequency; written only when used). QSTARS_ALI_NO_NEWTON (non-empty) turns the fallback off (build-35 behaviour). QSTARS_ALI_NEWTON_DUMP (non-empty, diagnostic): the first Newton Jacobian of each fallback frequency with J, Phi(J), CHI, CHI_SCAT, ETA to QSTARS_ALI_NEWTON_DUMP.bin (stream).
